properties.description: a_fixed_rule_violation_closes_through_its_typed_tool.rs, over the MCP surface: a barn 12 ft from a well against a 100 ft setback, flagged by violates_rule with detected_at; ruled rejected it is one open breach dated by detected_at, and its open_breach gap names set_violation_status and resolved_at and no raw edge write; set_violation_status rejected with resolved_at takes it off loop_status's breaches, keeping the edge with its evidence and both dates. resolved_at is refused with any status but rejected, and on a pair with no edge. The core test an_open_breach_reaches_the_loop.rs now closes its violation through the typed writer instead of create_edge.
properties.findings: On main 02e2739c8 both tests FAIL: violates_rule refuses detected_at and set_violation_status refuses resolved_at as unknown fields. With the fix both pass (2026-10-26).
properties.name: A must-fix rule violation closes through set_violation_status
